slides.heading: Start with Apple. See the complete evidence path.
slides.body: The AAPL reference shows how DeltaSignal turns one issuer question into a reusable research packet with SEC/XBRL evidence, ATLAS-7 interpretation, bounded agent synthesis, provenance, missingness, and explicit limits.

slides.heading: Most financial AI ends with fluent prose—and hides the evidence path.
slides.body: A polished answer is not enough for an analyst, compliance team, portfolio agent, or data-room workflow. They need source identity, dates, caveats, missingness, access state, and a packet another system can verify.

slides.heading: Discover. Invoke. Verify. Remember. Return.
slides.body: The Apple workflow moves from issuer identity and filing evidence through bounded ATLAS-7 tools, specialist review, labeled interpretation, and a reusable client packet—without allowing fluent explanation to replace proof.

slides.heading: After Apple, HUT proves the evidence system is reusable.
slides.body: The Apple workflow remains the flagship reference. A separate HUT TripCode then demonstrates research memory: TF-SUB-9DA70A7F98 resolves a 10-node River, links filing references, returns changed findings and weakened assumptions, preserves session context, creates monitor-next actions, and exposes usage metadata.

slides.heading: DeltaSignal is the specialist evidence node inside a larger agent ecosystem.
slides.body: Portfolio, compliance, data-room, and subscriber agents can discover the capability, invoke a bounded skill, inspect the returned evidence packet, and reuse it without rebuilding the SEC/XBRL and research-memory stack.

slides.heading: Facts remain facts. Interpretation stays labeled. Missing evidence stays missing.
slides.body: DeltaSignal does not ask users to trust an answer because it sounds intelligent. It gives agents and humans an evidence system they can inspect, rerun, monitor, and reuse.
